title: gmfren
tagline: Gmfren is your personal NFT portfolio tracker. Receive daily messages from gmfren as well as real-time updates whenever your listed tokens are sold or you receive a new offer.
description: Gmfren is your personal NFT portfolio tracker. Receive daily messages from gmfren as well as real-time updates whenever your listed tokens are sold or you receive a new offer. Gmfren is powered by Reservoir and EPSN. Visit https://gmfren.vercel.app/ to subscribe and get started today!
how_its_made: Gmfren is built using Reservoir's NFT API to track specific events impacting a user's NFT portfolio. Using EPNS Push Notification Service we are able to alert users who have opted-in to receive messages each time one of their listed tokens sells or they receive an offer on one of their tokens.
